title: Whose Tail Is This? Animal Tails for Kids with Milo
description:
Whose tail is this? Guess with Milo the bluebird, then find out what each tail can do: a lion's tail ends in a dark tuft like a paintbrush, a spider monkey's tail works like a third hand and even has lines like a fingerprint, and a giraffe's tail swats away buzzy flies.
An interactive animal guessing lesson for kids ages 2-6, with questions to answer, actions to copy, quick checks and a quiz at the end.
facts: Lion: a tuft covers a horny spur at the tip of the tail; tail just over half head-body length; large, padded feet; claws retractable and protected in a fleshy sheath; the mane covers head, neck, chest, elbows and sometimes belly (SDZWA Library fact sheet 'Lions', Physical Characteristics, ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/lions/characteristics, read Nov 16 2026).

Black spider monkey: a prehensile tail, a 'third hand' to grasp branches; the tail supports the entire weight of the monkey while both hands are free to forage; on the underside of the tip of the tail there is a patch of skin with lines like a fingerprint; diet primarily fruits, occasionally leaves, flowers and insects (Wisconsin National Primate Research Center, Primate Info Net fact sheet 'Black spider monkey', primate.wisc.edu, read Nov 16 2026).

Giraffe: long, black hair on the tail, used as an insect-swatter; tail 76-110 cm; long prehensile tongue, 50 cm (20 in); large hooved feet (SDZWA Library fact sheet 'Giraffes', Physical Characteristics, read Nov 16 2026).

segments.name: hello
lines: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are learning about animal tails!
What can a tail do?
Three animal friends will show us. Count them with me. One, two, three!
Get your guessing ready. Let's go!

segments.name: lion

lines.t: Whose tail has a fluffy tuft, at the very end?
Is it the lion's tail? Or is it the pig's tail?

lines: It is the lion!
Here is the fun fact. A lion's tail ends in a tuft of dark hair, like a paintbrush. Look, at the very tip!
Swish, swish! Can you see the tuft? It is dark and fluffy.

lines.t: How long is a lion's tail? Hmm.

lines: A little more than half as long as the lion's body! That is a long tail. Long, long, long!
Swish, swish goes the long tail.
close:lion
A lion has big, soft, padded feet. Pat, pat, pat!
And its claws hide away inside, until it needs them. Peekaboo, claws!
A grown-up boy lion has a big, fluffy mane.
The mane covers his head, his neck and his chest. What a big hairdo!
Say it with me. A lion's tail has a tuft!
close:host
Can you swish like a lion's tail? Swish, swish, swish! Side to side!
Now shake your mane, like a lion. Shake, shake!

lines.t: Quick check! What is at the end of a lion's tail? A tuft? Or a bow?

lines: A tuft! Like a paintbrush. Great job!

short.title: Why Does a Lion's Tail Look Like a Paintbrush?

segments.name: monkey

lines.t: Whose tail can hold on to a branch, like a hand?
Is it the spider monkey's tail? Or is it the cow's tail?

lines: It is the spider monkey!
Here is the fun fact. A spider monkey's tail works like a third hand!
It wraps its tail around a branch, and holds on tight.

lines.t: Can the tail hold up the whole monkey? Hmm.

lines: Yes! The tail can hold the whole monkey, so both hands are free to pick food.
Hanging on by its tail. Wow!
close:monkey
And here is a surprise. The tip of its tail has little lines underneath, like a fingerprint!
Look at your fingertip. Can you see little lines? A spider monkey has them on its tail!
What does a spider monkey eat? Mostly fruit! Yum!
It also eats some leaves, flowers, and bugs.
Say it with me. A spider monkey's tail can hold on!
close:host
Can you be a spider monkey? Reach up high, and swing, swing, swing!
Now look at your fingertips, and find the little lines.

lines.t: Quick check! What can a spider monkey's tail do? Hold on? Or fly?

lines: Hold on! Like a third hand. You remembered!

short.title: This Monkey's Tail Works Like a Hand!

segments.name: giraffe

lines.t: Whose long tail swats away buzzy flies?
Is it the giraffe's tail? Or is it the koala's tail?

lines: It is the giraffe!
Here is the fun fact. A giraffe's tail has long, black hair at the end.
It swishes its tail, to swat away buzzy flies. Swish! Bye-bye, flies!

lines.t: How long is a giraffe's tail? Hmm.

lines: It can be about as long as you are tall! Stand up tall, and see!
Swish, swish, goes the long tail.
close:giraffe
Now here is a giraffe surprise. A giraffe has a very long tongue!
Its tongue is about as long as your arm. It wraps around the leaves, and pulls them off.
A giraffe has big feet, with hooves.
Clip, clop! Big hooves, at the end of very long legs. Clip, clop, clip, clop!
Say it with me. A giraffe's tail swats flies!
close:host
Can you swish like a giraffe's tail? Swish, swish! Bye-bye, flies!
Now stick out your tongue, and reach for a leaf. Slurp!

lines.t: Quick check! What does a giraffe's tail swat away? Flies? Or snowflakes?

lines: Flies! Swish, swish. Super thinking!

short.title: What Does a Giraffe Do With Its Tail?

segments.name: quiz
lines: Wow! We met three friends with amazing tails. Now it is quiz time!
Get ready. Think hard!
quiz: Whose tail ends in a tuft, like a paintbrush?
Whose tail works like a third hand?
Whose tail swats away buzzy flies?

segments.name: goodbye
lines: You learned so many new things today.
Swish like a lion. Swing like a monkey. And swat flies like a giraffe!
Which tail is your favorite?
Thank you for learning with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
